summary:
Meeting #32 summary + team proposals.

STATUS: 6 CEO review gates remain the sole bottleneck. Team is ready and pre-staging work:
- Enzo: Regression suite ~70% done (timeline view), board view drag-and-drop complete. Full coverage by EOD tomorrow.
- Alice: Queued for command palette (2-3 days once gates clear). Doing Forge a11y audit in downtime.
- Andrei: Pre-writing CSS token hierarchy doc against worktree code.
- Jonah: Idle on Forge. Picking up event log rotation (backend hygiene) and available for small product improvements.

SEQUENCE REMINDER: (1) Approve visual themes gates → real QA (Enzo) → merge to main. (2) THEN approve command palette gates → Alice builds (2-3 days) → design review → QA. Merging themes first avoids style reconciliation issues.

NEW: 6 project pitches from the team (see deliverable). CEO picks which to greenlight:
1. Forge E2E test harness (Enzo) — Playwright suite for automated regression
2. Shared component library (Andrei) — Extract common patterns across products
3. Forge offline mode (Alice) — IndexedDB cache for offline viewing/editing
4. Cross-product event/notification system (Jonah) — Webhook bus across all products
5. Forge onboarding flow (Robert) — 3-step guided setup for new users
6. Cross-product analytics dashboard (Thomas) — PostHog data across all 5 products

Also discussed: SherlockPDF needs drag-and-drop upload + mobile responsiveness. QuoteVoice could use session history search. VoiceNote Pro has no retry logic on RevenueCat receipt validation (reliability fix, not feature).
feedback: No offline mode. I don't think that's necessary.
